title: Decentralized Object Store & Sync Engine — target architecture, as built where landed

elements.name: Object API client
elements.description: S3-style API consumer. Puts, gets, heads, deletes and lists objects through any node.

elements.name: Sync client
elements.description: Client replica that edits a CRDT metadata document offline and syncs it.
plannedNotes: Proposed in PLAN.md OQ-7; not decided.

elements.name: Operator
elements.description: Runs objnode processes, starts bucket migrations, reads membership and health.

elements.name: Developer or reader
elements.description: Runs simulation scenarios and replays a failing seed with the printed command.

elements.name: Decentralized Object Store & Sync Engine
elements.description: Leaderless, multi-region object store with a local-first metadata sync layer. A cluster of objnode peers; every node accepts reads and writes.

elements.name: Peer objnode nodes
elements.description: Other instances of the same system, in the same region and in other regions, as seen from one node.

elements.name: DST harness
elements.description: Deterministic simulation harness (internal/sim, internal/sim/simtest, cmd/objsim). Test system: a single-threaded discrete-event loop with virtual clock, seeded PRNG streams, fault-injecting network and disk, and nemesis.

elements.name: cmd/objnode
elements.description: CLI entry point for a storage and sync peer. Runs a node from flags or a config file.

elements.name: Node runtime (internal/node)
elements.description: Wires all primitives into one node and supplies the real runtime: UDP transport, TCP request/response transport, file-backed disk, wall clock, the node loop.
elements.technology: Go; UDP, TCP length-prefixed frames, files

elements.name: Object API (internal/storage)
elements.description: HTTP object API: put, get, head, delete, list, bucket create, tags and ACL, quota, metadata, migration start and status, membership and health; metadata sync endpoint.
plannedNotes: API surface is PLAN.md OQ-6; metadata sync endpoint is OQ-7.

elements.name: Storage engine (internal/storage)
elements.description: Local chunk store, shard placement, object put and get paths.

elements.name: Erasure coding (internal/erasure)
elements.description: GF(2^8) arithmetic and the Reed-Solomon encoder and decoder.

elements.name: Gossip membership (internal/gossip)
elements.description: SWIM membership: probe, indirect probe, suspicion state machine, piggybacked dissemination.

elements.name: Merkle anti-entropy (internal/merkle)
elements.description: Merkle tree builder, diff protocol, anti-entropy repair worker.

elements.name: CRDT metadata (internal/crdt)
elements.description: State-based CRDTs, hybrid logical clock, replication of CRDT state.

elements.name: Saga engine (internal/saga)
elements.description: Durable Saga orchestrator, log, recovery; the bucket-migration workflow definition.

elements.name: Environment interfaces (internal/env)
elements.description: The four interfaces protocol code sees: Clock, Rand, Transport, Disk; shared sentinels.

elements.name: Node disk
elements.description: Named blobs on the node's own disk: shard files and the Saga log.

elements.name: Join and leave
elements.description: Join through seed nodes; clean leave.

elements.name: Probe
elements.description: Per-period randomized probe of one member in shuffled round-robin order.

elements.name: Indirect probe
elements.description: Indirect probe through k others on timeout.

elements.name: Suspicion state machine
elements.description: Alive, suspect, dead; suspicion timeout scaled by log N; incarnation numbers for refutation.

elements.name: Piggybacked dissemination
elements.description: Piggybacked dissemination with a retransmit limit of lambda times log N.

elements.name: Full-state sync
elements.description: Periodic full-state sync with one random peer, including previously dead and seed addresses.

elements.name: Membership view and change events
elements.description: The Membership view and change events that the package exposes.

elements.name: GF(2^8) arithmetic
elements.description: Field GF(2^8), polynomial 0x11D, generator 2, exp/log tables.

elements.name: Matrix inversion
elements.description: Matrix inversion over GF(2^8).

elements.name: Systematic Cauchy coding matrix
elements.description: Coding matrix [I | C] with C a Cauchy matrix; k + m at most 256.

elements.name: Encode
elements.description: Encodes a stripe into k data and m parity shards.

elements.name: Reconstruct
elements.description: Rebuilds a stripe from any k shards; more than m losses returns ErrTooFewShards.

elements.name: Verify
elements.description: The Verify operation of the erasure package.

elements.name: Tree builder
elements.description: SHA-256 hash tree over a key-to-hash map; fixed-fanout trie on the hash of the key; incremental update.

elements.name: Diff protocol
elements.description: Exchanges roots and descends only mismatched branches, one level per round trip.

elements.name: Anti-entropy worker
elements.description: Picks a peer each period, diffs, and repairs through the Repairer interface.

elements.name: Repairer interface
elements.description: Interface the merkle package declares; repairs go through it.

elements.name: PN-Counter
elements.description: Storage quotas.

elements.name: OR-Set
elements.description: Bucket tags, ACL memberships. Classic form: unique add-tags plus a tombstone set.

elements.name: LWW-Register
elements.description: Object metadata, routing pointers, object manifests.

elements.name: LWW-Element-Set
elements.description: The fourth CRDT type in the spec's structure list.

elements.name: Hybrid logical clock
elements.description: LWW timestamps (wall, counter, node ID) with node-ID tie-break.

elements.name: Canonical encoding
elements.description: Encoding in which equal states are equal bytes.

elements.name: Typed metadata document
elements.description: A typed metadata document composed of the CRDT types.

elements.name: Replicator
elements.description: Exchanges state with random peers from a Membership interface: digest first, state on mismatch.

elements.name: Orchestrator
elements.description: Durable orchestrator: bounded retry with clock-driven backoff; compensations in reverse order, retried until they succeed; idempotency keys (saga ID + step).

elements.name: Saga log
elements.description: Append-only, checksummed log on env.Disk.

elements.name: Recovery
elements.description: Resumes or compensates from any log prefix.

elements.name: Bucket-migration workflow
elements.description: Allocate target, copy shards, verify Merkle root, flip routing pointer (the pivot), delete source.

elements.name: Step interfaces
elements.description: Small step interfaces the workflow is defined against; bound to the real components in Chunk 6.

elements.name: Shard file format
elements.description: 64-byte header plus payload, with per-shard SHA-256.

elements.name: Local chunk store
elements.description: Chunk store over env.Disk: atomic write, verified read, list, delete.

elements.name: Object striping
elements.description: Fixed-size stripes of 1 MiB of data so multi-MB objects stream.

elements.name: Object manifest
elements.description: Per object version: size, content SHA-256, k, m, stripe count, per-shard checksums, node chosen for each shard.

elements.name: Placement
elements.description: Region-aware placement by rendezvous hashing over a Membership interface.

elements.name: Object put and get paths
elements.description: PUT succeeds at k+1 durable shard acknowledgements plus a local manifest; GET reads any k verified shards; delete writes a tombstone manifest.
plannedNotes: Default k=4, m=2 and the k+1 write threshold are PLAN.md OQ-15.

elements.name: Environment interfaces (internal/env)
elements.description: The same package as element c-env, shown as a neighbour in the component views of other packages. The four interfaces protocol code sees: Clock, Rand, Transport, Disk; shared sentinels.

elements.name: Storage engine (internal/storage)
elements.description: The same package as element c-storage, shown as a neighbour in the component views of other packages. Local chunk store, shard placement, object put and get paths.

elements.name: CRDT metadata (internal/crdt)
elements.description: The same package as element c-crdt, shown as a neighbour in the component views of other packages. State-based CRDTs, hybrid logical clock, replication of CRDT state.

elements.name: Saga engine (internal/saga)
elements.description: The same package as element c-saga, shown as a neighbour in the component views of other packages. Durable Saga orchestrator, log, recovery; the bucket-migration workflow definition.

elements.name: Gossip membership (internal/gossip)
elements.description: The same package as element c-gossip, shown as a neighbour in the component views of other packages. SWIM membership: probe, indirect probe, suspicion state machine, piggybacked dissemination.

elements.name: Object API (internal/storage)
elements.description: The same package as element c-api, shown as a neighbour in the component views of other packages. HTTP object API: put, get, head, delete, list, bucket create, tags and ACL, quota, metadata, migration start and status, membership and health; metadata sync endpoint.
plannedNotes: API surface is PLAN.md OQ-6; metadata sync endpoint is OQ-7.

elements.description: The same package as element c-merkle, shown as a neighbour in the component views of other packages. Merkle tree builder, diff protocol, anti-entropy repair worker.

elements.description: The same package as element c-erasure, shown as a neighbour in the component views of other packages. GF(2^8) arithmetic and the Reed-Solomon encoder and decoder.
